remarks: Welcome to this sunny and bright corner unit with water views over Long Island Sound. This beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhome is on a serene waterfront peninsula and offers a year-round coastal lifestyle. Since 2021, updates include a refreshed kitchen with new appliances, flooring, countertops, backsplash, and painted cabinets, new floating laminate in the living room, updated baths with new vanities, toilets, and remodeled (2024), plus new carpeting upstairs (2024) and fresh paint throughout. Additional features include a newer slider in the primary bedroom (2020), new storm/screen door (2024), custom closet shelving (2025), and efficient wall units. Enjoy water views from multiple rooms, sunsets from the balcony, fireworks from the backyard, and public access to swimming, kayaking, and paddleboarding just across the street. This home offers relaxed, coastal living at its best.
